dns.page_description: Override carrier-assigned DNS servers with your preferred resolvers for all devices on the local network.
dns.error_at_least_one: Enter at least one DNS server address
dns.blocked_too_many: At most {{max}} servers in total. Clear one first.
dns.toast_error_apply: Could not apply the DNS settings
dns.save_failed_servers: The modem rejected one of these server addresses.
dns.error_load_desc: The modem did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
dns.unavailable_desc: The modem's DNS mode is set outside QManager. Until it is changed to PROXY, saving here has no effect.
dns.unavailable_title_unknown: Couldn't read the modem's DNS mode
dns.unavailable_desc_unknown: Saving here has no effect until the modem reports its DNS mode. Check again in a moment.
dns.banner_corrupt_desc: The modem's custom DNS settings are only partly written, so the servers shown may not be the ones in use.

resolver.title: Resolver
resolver.description: Which DNS servers the devices on your network are given.

ipv4.title: IPv4 Servers
ipv4.description: Tried in order. Four servers at most across both lists.

ipv6.title: IPv6 Servers
ipv6.description: For devices that use IPv6. They count toward the four.

mode.label: Custom DNS
mode.consequence_on: Devices on your network use the servers below.
mode.consequence_off: Devices use the servers your carrier assigns.

provider.label: Provider
provider.consequence: Fills both server lists. Editing an address makes it Custom.

ignore_carrier.label: Never fall back to carrier DNS
ignore_carrier.consequence_on: On, a lookup fails outright when your resolvers are unreachable rather than leaking to the carrier.
ignore_carrier.consequence_off: If your servers are unreachable, lookups fall back to the carrier's.

answering.label: Answering now
answering.source_custom: Your servers, as applied on the modem.
answering.source_carrier: Assigned by the carrier on the last attach.
answering.source_unknown: The modem could not tell where these came from.

traffic_engine.page_description: One bypass engine, two modes. Beat carrier video throttling on the hostnames you choose, or run the bypass on every web connection. Only one mode runs at a time.
traffic_engine.chart_aria: New connections handled per second over the last 60 seconds, peaking at {{max}}
traffic_engine.chart_aria_idle: No connections handled in the last 60 seconds
traffic_engine.chart_empty: Turn on a mode to see connections
traffic_engine.engine_desc: Pick a mode and watch the connections the engine handles.
traffic_engine.package_desc: The engine both modes share, and the redirect rule that feeds it traffic.
traffic_engine.pkg_status_busy: Removing it turns the running mode off first.
traffic_engine.pkg_status_idle: You can reinstall it from this page.
traffic_engine.advanced_dialog_desc: Both modes share this engine, so removing it turns off Video Optimizer and Full Bypass until you reinstall it.
traffic_engine.advanced_toast_error: Failed to remove the engine binary
traffic_engine.binary_op_failed_body: The last install or removal did not finish. Try again, or check System Logs.
traffic_engine.stale_body: The last poll didn't answer. The figures below are held from the previous read, and the engine keeps doing whatever it was doing.
traffic_engine.error_load_title: Could not read the Traffic Engine
traffic_engine.error_load_failed: The modem did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
traffic_engine.rule_banner_desc: The engine is running, but no traffic is sent to it, so the mode has no effect. Turn the mode off and on again to restore the rule.
traffic_engine.bypass_hint: Carriers spot tethered devices by the hop count their packets arrive with. Pinning every packet to 64 makes devices behind the modem look like the modem itself.
traffic_engine.bypass_helper_external: Set elsewhere to TTL {{ttl}} / HL {{hl}} (TTL page or a SIM profile). Manage it there.
traffic_engine.toast_video_enabled: Video Optimizer is now protecting video
traffic_engine.toast_install_error: Could not install the Traffic Engine
traffic_engine.onboarding_description: One install unlocks both Video Optimizer and Full Bypass. The download is checked against a pinned checksum first.
traffic_engine.video_tagline: Counters carrier throttling of video so it buffers less.
traffic_engine.video_how: Carrier DPI reads the hostname at the start of each connection to spot video. For the hostnames you list, the engine cuts that first message into pieces, splits the hostname mid-name and sends the pieces out of order, so the name never arrives whole.
traffic_engine.full_bypass_tagline: Runs the same split on every web connection, for carriers that throttle more than video.
traffic_engine.full_bypass_how: The same split as Video Optimizer, applied to every TCP connection on ports 80 and 443 instead of a hostname list. There is nothing to configure.
traffic_engine.strip_aria: The handshake goes out in pieces, with the hostname cut mid-name and sent out of order, so the carrier never reads it whole.
traffic_engine.foot_other_owns: {{mode}} owns the engine. Switch modes above to use this one.
traffic_engine.foot_idle: Turn on {{mode}} from the Mode control above.
traffic_engine.foot_hosts_live: Applies to new connections right away, with no restart.
traffic_engine.foot_switch_to_apply: Takes effect when you switch the engine to {{mode}}.
traffic_engine.foot_on_enable: Takes effect when you turn on {{mode}}.
traffic_engine.foot_hosts_empty: Keep at least one hostname to apply.
traffic_engine.hosts_desc: The video CDN domains Video Optimizer works on.
traffic_engine.hosts_empty_desc: Add a video CDN domain above, or restore the defaults.
traffic_engine.hosts_invalid: Enter a valid domain (letters, digits, dots, dashes).
traffic_engine.hosts_duplicate: This domain is already in the list.
traffic_engine.hosts_limit: The list can hold at most 300 domains.
traffic_engine.hosts_too_long: A domain can be at most {{max}} characters.
traffic_engine.import_invalid_one: 1 line was not a valid domain.
traffic_engine.import_dropped_one: 1 did not fit under the {{max}} domain limit.
traffic_engine.import_dropped_other: {{count}} did not fit under the {{max}} domain limit.
traffic_engine.import_too_large: That file is too large. Pick a target list under {{limit}} KB.
traffic_engine.import_unreadable: That file could not be read.
traffic_engine.dialog_restore_desc: This will replace the current list with the factory default CDN hostnames. Any custom domains you added will be removed.
traffic_engine.force_tcp_description: Blocks QUIC (UDP 443) so apps like YouTube and Discord fall back to HTTPS over TCP, where the engine's bypass can apply.
traffic_engine.force_tcp_hint: Applies immediately. Works with either mode, and with neither.
traffic_engine.force_tcp_caveat: Can stream slower: if your network already delivers QUIC at full speed, forcing it to TCP adds latency (plus the bypass hop). Enable when QUIC video is throttled or unreliable.
traffic_engine.verify_description: Measures whether bypassing DPI would speed up a throttled video CDN on this connection, against an unthrottled reference. It uses its own temporary proxy, so it doesn't check the engine you have running.
traffic_engine.verify_progress: Downloading the same file twice — once direct, once through a temporary proxy — plus a reference sample. This takes a few minutes.
traffic_engine.verify_timeout: The test did not finish in time.
traffic_engine.verify_error: The test could not be started
traffic_engine.verify_headline_sub: faster through the bypass in this test
traffic_engine.verify_scope: This measures your connection, not the engine that's running. Check the live state above for that.
traffic_engine.verify_footnote: Line speed is the reference: a slow result on all three is a slow connection, not throttling.
